senses: n. 方便，便利；便利的事物（或设施）
convenience.usage: con（都）+venien（发音类似“为您”）+ce（名词后缀）→现在各个商家都为了您的“方便”推出各种策略。

ex.en: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
ex.zh: 为方便顾客我们备有座位。

ex.en: Customers pay a small fee for the convenience of home delivery.
ex.zh: 顾客为送货上门的便利支付少量费用。

ex.en: The new metro station was built for the convenience of commuters in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 新建地铁站是为了方便郊区的通勤者。

senses: adj. 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的

ex.en: A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
ex.zh: 在城镇骑自行车常常比开车更方便。

ex.en: The hotel is convenient for both the airport and the exhibition centre.
ex.zh: 这家酒店到机场和展览中心都很方便。

ex.en: Critics say online shopping is convenient but encourages wasteful packaging.
ex.zh: 批评者说，网购虽然方便，却助长了浪费的包装。

senses: n. [C] （某职业、政党等成员的）大会，集会
n. 社会习俗;常规,惯例
convention.usage: [族] conventional a. 传统的；常规的；n.习俗，惯例；大会；公约， 协定；con（所有的）+vention（发音类似“文身”）→某地所有居民都文身，因为文身是这里的“风俗，传统”→风俗。；词根:con(together一起)+vent(come来)+(t)ion(名词后缀)→一起来→大会；索引p405

ex.en: The BIO recently held a convention.
ex.zh: 生物科技行业组织（BIO）最近召开了一次会议。

ex.en: By convention, the oldest member of the committee chairs the opening session.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，委员会中年纪最大的成员主持开幕会议。

ex.en: Delegates from forty countries attended the annual convention held in Chicago.
ex.zh: 来自四十个国家的代表出席了在芝加哥举行的年会。

senses: adj. 传统的；习惯的；常规的

phrases.p: a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media
phrases.m: 传统付费媒体以外的广泛因素

ex.en: She's very conventional in her views.
ex.zh: 她的观点很守旧。

ex.en: Conventionally, new employees receive induction training during their first week at the firm.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，新员工在入职公司的第一周接受岗前培训。

senses: v. 汇合,集中,聚会,汇集;趋同
vi. 趋于一致；汇集；交汇
converge.usage: 词根:con(together共同)+verge(turn朝着)→朝着共同的方向→趋于一致;辨析:collect指有计划、有选择地收集并整理;gather指人或抽象事物的聚集、搜集情报;assemble指因某种目的集合并形成群体;converge侧重汇聚在某一点；索引p405

ex.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
ex.zh: 年轻人和老年人在一个关键问题上看法一致：两个年龄组中的绝大多数人表示，他们觉得现在年轻人的人生起步要比前几代人更难。

ex.en: The survey shows that most job interviews begin with a short conversation.
ex.zh: 调查显示，大多数求职面试都以简短的交谈开始。

ex.en: He tried to steer the conversation away from his recent dismissal.
ex.zh: 他试图把谈话从自己最近被解雇的话题上引开。

ex.en: Eye contact keeps a conversation alive and signals genuine interest.
ex.zh: 眼神交流能让谈话保持活跃，并显示出真正的兴趣。

converse.usage: v.谈话，交谈 n.相反的事物，反面说法 adj.相反的，逆向的

conversely.usage: adv.相反地，反过来说；con（共同）+verse（转，改变）+ly（副词后缀）→完全改变→相反地；词根记忆：con(together, 一起)+vers(turn, 转)+e+ly(副词后缀)→一起转向相反方向地→相反地；索引p405

ex.en: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
ex.zh: 相反，如果家庭作业很重要，那么它应该占到分数的很大一部分。

ex.en: Urban rents keep rising; conversely, house prices in rural areas continue to fall.
ex.zh: 城市租金不断上涨；相反，农村地区的房价持续下跌。

ex.en: Exporters welcome a weak currency; conversely, importers are hurt by it.
ex.zh: 出口商欢迎疲软的货币；相反，进口商则因此受损。

ex.en: Regular exercise improves sleep; conversely, poor sleep reduces the motivation to exercise.
ex.zh: 规律锻炼能改善睡眠；相反，睡眠不佳会削弱锻炼的意愿。

senses: n. 转变，变换；(信仰)改变，皈依

ex.en: loft conversion
ex.zh: 阁楼改造

ex.en: The conversion of the old warehouse into flats took eighteen months.
ex.zh: 把旧仓库改建为公寓花了十八个月。

ex.en: The factory completed its conversion from coal to natural gas last year.
ex.zh: 该工厂去年完成了从燃煤到天然气的转换。

convert.usage: transform 的近义词；con-（完全）+vert（转）→完全转变→转变。近义：transform vt. 转变；辨析：convert 指(转)变；connect 连接；conduct 引导；contact 联系；con（一起，共同）+vert（=turn转，改变）→一起转→转变；词根记忆：con(complet

ex.en: A lot of conventional farmers have converted to organic production.
ex.zh: 许多传统农民已经转向有机生产。

ex.en: convert all the suitable land to fields of fruit and veg
ex.zh: 将所有适合的土地都变为果园和菜园

ex.en: The old factory was converted into a museum of modern art.
ex.zh: 这座旧工厂被改建成了一座现代艺术博物馆。

convey.usage: transmit 的近义词；[近]deliver vt. 递送；v.传送，运输；表达，传递 Domesticcrudeoil 主要被一些entrepreneurs 控制。Hence,私自开采原油成为epidemic。一些政客和 futurists 认为，应该preserve 原油，但是复杂的proced；con(表示"

ex.en: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.
ex.zh: 红色之类的颜色可给人以充满活力与力量的感觉。

ex.en: In some settings, red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much.
ex.zh: 在有些场合，红色运动鞋或T恤连衣裙可以彰显身份，但在其他场合则并非如此。

ex.en: Simple charts are often the best way to convey complex data to the public.
ex.zh: 简单的图表往往是向公众传达复杂数据的最佳方式。

senses: vt. [律](经审讯)证明……有罪，宣判……有罪
vt. 使深感有罪，使服罪
convict.usage: v.宣判……有罪 n.囚犯；con（加强）+vict（征服，克服）→把对方彻底征服，需要证明（对方）有罪→定罪。；索引p405

ex.en: The jury convicted him of fraud after a six-week trial.
ex.zh: 经过六周的审理，陪审团裁定他犯有诈骗罪。

ex.en: The escaped convict was recaptured within forty-eight hours.
ex.zh: 那名越狱囚犯在四十八小时内被再次抓获。

ex.en: Two managers were convicted of conspiracy to sell company secrets.
ex.zh: 两名经理被判密谋出售公司机密罪。

senses: n. 判罪；坚定的信念（或主张）；坚信

phrases.p: have the courage of one's convictions
phrases.m: 有勇气做自己认为对的事

ex.en: He appealed against his conviction, claiming that new evidence had emerged.
ex.zh: 他对定罪提出上诉，声称出现了新的证据。

ex.en: She argued her case with quiet conviction and won over the committee.
ex.zh: 她以沉稳坚定的信念陈述理由，说服了委员会。

ex.en: This is his second conviction for dangerous driving.
ex.zh: 这是他第二次因危险驾驶被定罪。

convince.usage: v.使确信，使信服；说服， 劝服；v.使确信，使信服；说服，劝 服；con（表示“共同”）+vinc（表示“征服”）+e（动词后缀）→共同征服→使信服，使确信。；索引p405

ex.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
ex.zh: 如果花一年时间去探索兴趣的内在价值还不足以令你信服，那么考虑一下它对未来学业选择的经济影响吧。

ex.en: You will be happy to convince people with bad arguments.
ex.zh: 你会很乐意用错误的论点说服别人。

ex.en: It took hours of discussion to convince the board that the plan was safe.
ex.zh: 花了数小时的讨论才让董事会相信该计划是安全的。

convincing.usage: adj.令人信服的，有说服力的；索引p405

ex.en: The defence lawyer presented a convincing argument that seriously undermined the prosecution's case.
ex.zh: 辩护律师提出了一个令人信服的论点，严重削弱了控方的指控。

ex.en: My grandmother taught me to cook simple meals with whatever vegetables were in season.
ex.zh: 祖母教我用当季现有的蔬菜烹制简单的饭菜。

phrases.m: (使某人)冷静、镇静或降低热情

cool.usage: 助记:音"酷",夏天喝凉茶很酷；adj.凉的；冷静的；酷的；冷漠 的 v.冷却，变凉；冷静

ex.en: Fans were installed to cool the servers during the summer heat.
ex.zh: 安装了风扇，以便在夏季高温期间给服务器降温。

ex.en: Keep the sauce in a cool place before serving.
ex.zh: 上桌前把调味汁存放在阴凉处。

ex.en: His response to the criticism was calm and cool.
ex.zh: 他对批评的回应冷静而沉着。

senses: v. 合作，协作；协助，配合
cooperate.usage: 助记:co(一起)+oper(工作)+ate(动词后缀)→一起工作→合作；co(表示"一起")+operate(操作；手术)→一起操作→合作；cooperate with sb in doing sth。；词根记忆: co(together, 一起)+oper(work, 工作)+ate(动词后缀)→一起工作→合作；索

ex.en: They also help him understand that people must cooperate and work toward common goals.
ex.zh: 他们还帮助他理解，人们必须合作，朝着共同的目标努力。

ex.en: The police cooperated with the local residents.
ex.zh: 警方与当地居民进行了合作。

ex.en: Among the children who had not been tricked, the majority were willing to cooperate with the tester in learning a new skill, demonstrating that they trusted his leadership.
ex.zh: 没有被欺骗的孩子大多数愿意与测试员合作来学习一项新技能，这证明他们信任他的领导。

ex.en: Solving climate change requires close cooperation among all major economies.
ex.zh: 解决气候变化问题需要所有主要经济体密切合作。

ex.en: The police thanked the public for their cooperation during the investigation.
ex.zh: 警方感谢公众在调查期间的配合。

ex.en: Without international cooperation, no country can control the spread of new viruses alone.
ex.zh: 没有国际合作，任何国家都无法单独控制新病毒的传播。

senses: n. 合作社组织，合作企业
cooperative.usage: 助记:co(一起)+oper(工作)+ative(形容词后缀)→一起工作的→合作的；adj.合作的，协作的；配合的 n.合作组织；索引p405

ex.en: Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together.
ex.zh: 换句话说，内疚感可以帮助一个合作性的种群凝聚在一起。

ex.en: The children were unusually cooperative during the fire drill.
ex.zh: 孩子们在消防演习中异常配合。

ex.en: The dairy is run as a cooperative owned by local farmers.
ex.zh: 这家乳品厂是作为当地农民拥有的合作社来经营的。

ex.en: The two laboratories agreed to take a cooperative approach to vaccine research.
ex.zh: 两个实验室同意在疫苗研究上采取合作方式。

senses: v. 使协调；使相配合；协调；搭配
vt. 使协调；使相互配合
coordinate.usage: 派生coordination n.协调,协同;coordinator n.协调人,统筹者；v.协调，配合；搭配；co（一起）+ordinate（联想ordinary“普通的”）→普通人要一起配合→协调。；词根记忆: co(together, 共同)+ordin(order, 命令)+ate(动词后缀)→命令各方协调→使

ex.en: The bed linen coordinates with the bedroom curtains.
ex.zh: 床单和卧室的窗帘很相配。

ex.en: It might also be hard for airlines to coordinate the departure times and destinations of passenger aircraft in a way that would allow them to gain from formation flight.
ex.zh: 编队飞行将让航空公司可以获利，但航空公司可能也很难以这一方式协调客机的起飞时间和目的地。

ex.en: A special agency was created to coordinate disaster relief across the region.
ex.zh: 成立了一个专门机构来协调整个地区的救灾工作。

ex.en: It is difficult to coordinate the schedules of twenty volunteers.
ex.zh: 协调二十名志愿者的时间安排非常困难。

ex.en: Effective coordination between the police and fire services was essential during the emergency evacuation.
ex.zh: 在紧急疏散过程中，警方与消防部门之间的有效协作至关重要。

cope.usage: 助记:缩小scope(范围),更好cope(对付)；v.对付，处理 这种crop 被deemed as 该地区经济的支柱，也是该地区fame 的重要部分。所以，当地政府对其attach great importance，deliberately 地exert 了各种措施，尽管costly，也；谐音"靠谱"→你处理这些事

ex.en: They are able to cope with the global climate change.
ex.zh: 他们能够应对全球气候变化。

ex.en: Hospitals struggled to cope with the sudden influx of patients.
ex.zh: 医院难以应对突然涌入的病人。

ex.en: She copes well with pressure, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙碌的几周，她也能很好地应对压力。

ex.en: Many families cannot cope with the rising cost of childcare.
ex.zh: 许多家庭无力应对不断上涨的育儿开支。

senses: adj. 丰富的;大量的;过量的

ex.en: The tools, made of copper, were discovered beneath the ruins of a Bronze Age settlement.
ex.zh: 这些铜制工具是在一处青铜时代聚落的遗址下发现的。

senses: n. 复制品；（书报的）一份

ex.en: Please attach a copy of your passport to the application form before submitting it online.
ex.zh: 在线提交申请表之前，请随附一份护照复印件。

copyright.usage: 助记:copy(复制)+right(权利)→复制的权力→版权；索引p405

ex.en: The publisher holds the copyright to the translations and can prevent other firms from reprinting them.
ex.zh: 出版商拥有这些译本的版权，可以阻止其他公司擅自重印。

cord.usage: 助记:corn(玉米)用cord(绳)穿起来挂着;the vocal cords声带

senses: adj. 热情友好的,热诚的,真心的
adj. 有兴奋作用的;深深感到的
n. 核心(团体)；(问题的)核心；果心；(物体的)中心部分
core.usage: cor(心)+e→和心脏作用一样→最重要的；近heart，反margin；助记:种corn(庄稼)是农民的core(核心)工作；n.果核；中心部分；核心 v.去核 adj.核心的，最重要的；索引p405

ex.en: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
ex.zh: 以法国为首的"南方"阵营所求不同：在欧元区核心成员国内部建立"欧洲经济政府"。

ex.en: Data analysis is now a core skill in almost every profession.
ex.zh: 数据分析如今几乎是各行各业的一项核心技能。

ex.en: The reform strikes at the core of the country's voting system.
ex.zh: 这项改革直击该国投票制度的核心。

ex.en: Cut the apple in half and remove the core.
ex.zh: 把苹果切成两半，去掉果核。

ex.en: Farmers in the region have switched from wheat to corn because it needs far less water.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民已从小麦改种玉米，因为玉米需水少得多。

ex.en: She waited at the corner of the street, watching the buses pass one after another.
ex.zh: 她在街角等候，看着公共汽车一辆接一辆地驶过。

senses: adj. (只用于名词前)公司的,社团的
adj. 组成公司(或团体)的,法人的
corporate.usage: adj.公司的；共同的，全 体的 n.公司，集团；词根记忆：corpor(body，身体)+ate(具有…的)→成为一体的→法人实体的；corporate value企业价值；CSR企业社会责任；索引p405

ex.en: The scandal damaged the company's corporate image beyond repair.
ex.zh: 这起丑闻使该公司的企业形象受到不可挽回的损害。

ex.en: Corporate taxes fund a significant share of public services.
ex.zh: 公司税为公共服务提供了相当大的资金份额。

ex.en: Executives defended their corporate culture before the parliamentary committee.
ex.zh: 高管们在议会委员会面前为其企业文化辩护。

senses: n. 公司;法人,法人团体
corporation.usage: 辨析:corporation尤指跨国公司等大企业;company常指生产/出售产品或服务性公司;firm指商号,可大可小；索引p405

ex.en: The city sold its water system to a private corporation.
ex.zh: 这座城市把供水系统卖给了一家私营公司。

ex.en: Multinational corporations can shift profits to countries with lower taxes.
ex.zh: 跨国公司可以把利润转移到税率较低的国家。

ex.en: The corporation employs more people than the entire local government.
ex.zh: 这家公司雇用的人数比整个地方政府还多。

senses: a. 正确的；合适的；得体的
correct.usage: 助记:cor(加强意义)+rect(正,直)→把弯曲的东西变直→改正

ex.en: Teachers encourage pupils to correct their own mistakes rather than simply memorising model answers.
ex.zh: 教师鼓励学生改正自己的错误，而不是死记标准答案。

senses: v. 相关联；使相互关联
correlate.usage: 助记:cor(共同的)+relate(有关)→互相关联;派生correlation n.相互的关系；v.相互关联 n.相关的事物；索引p405

ex.en: That's because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty.
ex.zh: 那是因为经济增长可能与环境退化有关，而保护环境有时与更严重的贫困有关。

ex.en: The study found that income levels correlate strongly with life expectancy.
ex.zh: 研究发现，收入水平与预期寿命密切相关。

ex.en: Teachers noticed that hours of sleep correlate with students' performance in morning classes.
ex.zh: 老师们注意到，睡眠时长与学生在上午课堂上的表现相关。

ex.en: Researchers found a strong correlation between reading habits and exam results.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现阅读习惯与考试成绩之间有很强的相关性。

ex.en: A correlation does not by itself prove that one factor causes the other.
ex.zh: 相关性本身并不能证明一个因素导致另一个因素。

ex.en: The study shows a clear correlation between exercise and improved mood.
ex.zh: 该研究显示了锻炼与情绪改善之间的明显相关性。

senses: v. 相一致，相符合；类似于，相当于；通信
vi. 相一致；相当于；通信
correspond.usage: 助记:cor(共同)+respond(反应)→共鸣→相符合;辨析:correspond与with/to连用表相等,符合;associate与with连用表交往,结交;connect表连接,结合;communicate表联络,通信；v.类似，相当；通信；一致， 符合；词根:cor(together共同)+re(back还

ex.en: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim—a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
ex.zh: 最终，一项科学发现声明被人们所相信——这个过程恰与哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的"思想的共性"一致。

ex.en: The written records correspond closely with the physical evidence found at the site.
ex.zh: 书面记录与现场发现的实物证据非常吻合。

ex.en: The two researchers corresponded for years but never met in person.
ex.zh: 这两位研究者通信多年，却从未见过面。

correspondence.usage: 助记:correspond(通信)+ence(名词后缀)→通信;词组bring...into correspondence with...使……与……一致起来；n.信件，信函；通信；关联；索引p405

ex.en: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
ex.zh: 智能手机可能存有被捕者的浏览历史、财务历史、病史以及近期通信的全面记录。

ex.en: He kept a twenty-year correspondence with his former professor.
ex.zh: 他与他以前的教授保持了二十年的通信往来。

ex.en: There is a close correspondence between what the firm promises and what it delivers.
ex.zh: 该公司所作承诺与实际交付之间高度一致。

senses: n. 通信者,通讯员,记者
correspondent.usage: 助记:correspond(通信)+ent(名词后缀)→通信者；索引p405

ex.en: Our correspondent in Berlin reports that the negotiations have entered a critical stage.
ex.zh: 本报驻柏林记者报道，谈判已进入关键阶段。

phrases.p: on both sides of the corridor

corridor.usage: 记：cor（跑）+rid+-or（名词后缀）→课间嬉笑跑跳的狭长空间→走廊

ex.en: The new office building has a long central corridor lined with meeting rooms on both sides.
ex.zh: 新办公楼有一条长长的中央走廊，两侧都是会议室。

senses: v. (渐渐)损害,(一点一点地)损伤
adj. 堕落的,腐败的,贪赃舞弊的
v. 使堕落,腐蚀;向……行贿
v. 使腐化；使堕落；破坏；损坏
adj. 贪污的；受贿的；腐败的；营私舞弊的

phrases.p: the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland
phrases.m: 葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰被破坏的自然风光

corrupt.usage: 助记:cor(整个)+rupt(打破)→人格整个被打破→堕落的;同义wicked,evil,rotten,dishonest;派生corruptible adj.会腐败的;可贿赂的；发音类似“可抓捕他”→他因贪污腐败被抓捕→腐败的，贪污的。派生：corruption；词根记忆: cor(together, 共同)+ru

ex.en: It was seen as the only way to overthrow a corrupt regime.
ex.zh: 这被视为推翻腐败政权的唯一方法。

ex.en: Corrupt officials accepted bribes in exchange for construction permits.
ex.zh: 腐败官员收受贿赂，以换取建筑许可。

ex.en: Unlimited power tends to corrupt even well-intentioned leaders.
ex.zh: 不受约束的权力往往会腐蚀哪怕出于善意的领导者。

ex.en: The corrupt judge was removed from office and later prosecuted.
ex.zh: 那位贪腐法官被免职，后来还受到了起诉。

corruption.usage: n.腐败；堕落；corrupt 的派生词；索引p405

ex.en: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
ex.zh: 法官们判定，仅仅是帮助送礼者接近其他官员，只要未带有明显的胁迫这些官员的意图，就不算贿赂。

ex.en: The new government promised an uncompromising campaign against corruption.
ex.zh: 新政府承诺开展一场不妥协的反腐败运动。

ex.en: Investigative journalists exposed deep corruption within the housing authority.
ex.zh: 调查记者揭露了住房管理部门内部根深蒂固的腐败。

ex.en: Voters rank corruption among the most serious problems facing the country.
ex.zh: 选民将腐败列为该国面临的最严重问题之一。

corruptive.usage: adj.使堕落的；腐败性的；索引p405

ex.en: Reformers argued that the corruptive influence of money in politics had weakened public trust.
ex.zh: 改革者认为，政治中金钱的腐蚀作用削弱了公众的信任。

cosmic.usage: 助记:cosm(宇宙)+ic(形容词后缀)→宇宙的；adj.宇宙的；巨大的，极重要 的

ex.en: The telescope detected cosmic radiation dating back billions of years to the early universe.
ex.zh: 这台望远镜探测到了可追溯至数十亿年前宇宙早期的宇宙辐射。

phrases.m: 不惜任何代价,无论任何

cost.usage: 派生costly adj.费钱的,昂贵的

ex.en: The rising cost of housing has forced many young workers to move to the outskirts.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本迫使许多年轻劳动者迁往郊区。

senses: adj. 不花钱的；无须付出代价的
a. 昂贵的；造成损失的
costly.usage: adj.昂贵的，值钱的；代价大的

ex.en: Buying new furniture may prove too costly.
ex.zh: 购买新家具可能会花钱太多。

ex.en: The delay proved costly: the firm lost its largest customer.
ex.zh: 拖延的代价高昂：公司失去了最大的客户。

ex.en: Removing the old pipelines turned out to be far more costly than expected.
ex.zh: 拆除旧管道的成本结果远超预期。

ex.en: A single accounting error led to a costly lawsuit.
ex.zh: 一次账目差错引发了一场代价高昂的诉讼。

costume.usage: 派生costumier n.服装制作人；n.服装，装束；表演服装

ex.en: Visitors to the heritage park can rent a Victorian costume for the day.
ex.zh: 到这座历史遗址公园游览的游客可以租一套维多利亚时代的服装穿一整天。

senses: adj. 亲切友好的；自满的,自得的

ex.en: They spent their summer holiday in a stone cottage overlooking the quiet valley.
ex.zh: 他们在一座俯瞰宁静山谷的石砌村舍里度过了暑假。

senses: n. [U] 棉花；[C] 棉线，棉布
n. 棉花,棉线,棉纱,棉制品

ex.en: The region's economy once depended almost entirely on the export of raw cotton.
ex.zh: 该地区的经济曾经几乎完全依赖原棉出口。

senses: n. 长沙发,睡椅,长榻;诊察台
v. (用某种文体或方式)表达,措辞

ex.en: He lay on the couch, too exhausted to move after the twelve-hour shift.
ex.zh: 他躺在沙发上，经过十二小时的轮班后累得动弹不得。

ex.en: The doctor advised her to seek further tests if the cough persisted beyond two weeks.
ex.zh: 医生建议，如果咳嗽持续超过两周，她应做进一步检查。

senses: modal v. 能；可以（can的过去式）
modal v. 能；可能；（用于建议）可以
aux.v. [语气婉转的请求]能,[虚拟语气]能,可以

ex.en: A century ago, few people could have imagined that computers would reshape daily life so profoundly.
ex.zh: 一个世纪前，很少有人能想到计算机会如此深刻地重塑日常生活。

ex.en: He won a seat on the council.
ex.zh: 他赢得了议会的一个席位。

ex.en: The city council has approved funds for three new public libraries.
ex.zh: 市议会已批准为三座新公共图书馆拨款。

ex.en: The council meets every Thursday to discuss local housing issues.
ex.zh: 理事会每周四开会讨论当地的住房问题。

senses: n. 律师；法律顾问；忠告，劝告
v. 建议；劝告；提供专业咨询
counsel.usage: n.忠告，建议；辩护律师 v.建议，劝告；为……提供咨询；coun（联想can“能”）+sel（联想sell）→能不能卖要问“法律顾问”。；索引p405

ex.en: Listen to the counsel of your elders.
ex.zh: 要听从长辈的忠告。

ex.en: The doctor counseled the patient about the risks and benefits of the operation.
ex.zh: 医生就手术的风险与益处向病人作了劝导说明。

ex.en: Against the counsel of his lawyers, he decided to speak to the press.
ex.zh: 不顾律师的劝告，他决定向媒体发言。

count.usage: 另:count for much(nothing,little)很有(没有、很少)价值；count backward倒数；count in把…计算在内；count for值…；索引p405

ex.en: The final count showed that the candidate had won by three hundred votes.
ex.zh: 最终计票显示，该候选人以三百票的优势获胜。

ex.en: In job interviews, first impressions count more than long explanations.
ex.zh: 在求职面试中，第一印象比长篇解释更重要。

ex.en: The charity counts on volunteers to run its weekend food bank.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构依靠志愿者来运营其周末食物银行。

counter.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“反对”→说出理由来反对别人的观点→反驳；count(数数)+er(名词后缀)→数数的物品就是"计算器"，引申为"柜台"；采取相反的立场就是"反驳"；counter- 前缀表“反对”：counterattack 反击，counterpart 对应物。；索引p405

ex.en: It runs counter to the existing literature on the subject.
ex.zh: 这与关于这一主题的现有文献背道而驰。

ex.en: The minister countered the opposition's claims.
ex.zh: 部长反驳了反对派的说法。

ex.en: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
ex.zh: 然后我用另一个合理的论点反驳：提高最低工资将迫使企业雇用更少的员工，并且缩短他们的工时。

counteract.usage: v.抵制，抵消，中和；词根记忆：counter(against,相反)+act(do,做)→往相反的效果做→抵消。；索引p405

ex.en: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
ex.zh: 巴纳研究所的总编罗克珊·斯通说："这表明在抵消这个问题的影响方面确实存在个人责任。"

ex.en: Exercise can counteract some of the harm caused by long periods of sitting.
ex.zh: 锻炼能抵消久坐造成的部分伤害。

ex.en: The government introduced subsidies to counteract the impact of rising fuel prices.
ex.zh: 政府推出补贴，以抵消燃料价格上涨的影响。

counterbalance.usage: n.平衡力，抗衡力 v.使……平衡，抵消，抗衡；例句2017年完形，跨前页；索引p405

ex.en: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs.
ex.zh: 如今，因为大多数工作者几乎没有业余时间，所以人们利用空闲时间来平衡工作中的理智和情感需求。

ex.en: Strong exports counterbalance the weakness of domestic demand.
ex.zh: 强劲的出口抵消了国内需求的疲软。

ex.en: The media serve as a counterbalance to unchecked political power.
ex.zh: 媒体是对不受制约的政治权力的制衡力量。

senses: n. (职务、性格、作用等)相对应的人或物
n. 职位(或作用)相当的人；对应的事物
counterpart.usage: 助记:counter(相对的)+part(部分)→相对应的人(或物)；词根记忆：counter(against, 相对)+part(部分)→相对的部分→对应的人（或物）；索引p405

ex.en: It sends a mixed message, and your counterpart gets to choose what signals to read.
ex.zh: 这会使信息混淆，而你的交流对象就会选择性地接收信息。

ex.en: The foreign minister held talks with her French counterpart in Paris.
ex.zh: 外交部长在巴黎与法国外长举行了会谈。

ex.en: The German company moved far faster than its American counterpart.
ex.zh: 这家德国公司的行动远比其美国同行迅速。

ex.en: The UK regulator works closely with its counterparts across Europe.
ex.zh: 英国监管机构与欧洲各国的同行密切合作。

country.usage: 辨析:country重疆土,nation重人民,state重政权、政体

ex.en: The country has invested heavily in renewable energy to reduce its dependence on imported oil.
ex.zh: 该国在可再生能源上投入巨资，以减少对进口石油的依赖。

ex.en: High-speed railways now make it possible to live in the countryside while working in the city.
ex.zh: 如今高速铁路使居住在乡村而在城市工作成为可能。

senses: n. 一对夫妇；一对情侣

ex.en: The elderly couple donated most of their savings to the village school where they first met.
ex.zh: 这对老夫妇把大部分积蓄捐给了他们初次相识的乡村学校。

senses: n. [U] 勇气；胆量；勇敢；无畏

phrases.p: pluck up courage/screw up one's courage

courage.usage: 词组take one's courage in both hands鼓起勇气做事；词根记忆：cour(heart,心)+age(名词后缀)→下定决心→勇气；索引p405

ex.en: It took great courage for the clerk to expose the fraud.
ex.zh: 那位职员揭发欺诈行为需要极大的勇气。

ex.en: The soldiers were honoured for their courage under heavy fire.
ex.zh: 这些士兵因在猛烈炮火下的英勇表现而受到表彰。

ex.en: Moral courage often matters more than physical bravery in public life.
ex.zh: 在公共生活中，道德勇气往往比身体上的勇敢更重要。

ex.en: It was courageous of her to challenge the board's decision in public.
ex.zh: 她公开质疑董事会的决定，着实勇敢。

ex.en: The courageous firefighter rushed into the burning building to save the trapped child.
ex.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员冲进燃烧的大楼去救被困的孩子。

ex.en: A courageous journalist must be prepared to defend the truth against powerful interests.
ex.zh: 勇敢的记者必须准备好捍卫真相、对抗强大的利益集团。

course.usage: 词组run/take its course听其自然发展;按常规进行;stay the course坚持到底;was on/off course(飞机)航向正确/偏离航向；索引p405

ex.en: Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults.
ex.zh: 在它（指经济大萧条）结束之前，它很可能会影响人们的人生历程，改变年轻一代的性格。

ex.en: She decided to take an online course in statistics to improve her analytical skills.
ex.zh: 她决定修一门统计学在线课程来提升自己的分析能力。

ex.en: In the course of the debate, several speakers questioned the reliability of the data.
ex.zh: 在辩论过程中，好几位发言者对数据的可靠性提出了质疑。

senses: v. 讨好;(向女子)求爱,求婚;设法获得,企图得到;招致,酿成,导致
court.usage: 文化休息站：美国法院分联邦法院和州法院两大系统，联邦法院由1个最高法院、13个上诉法院和94个地方法院组成；索引p405

ex.en: The case will be heard in the highest court of the state next month.
ex.zh: 该案将于下月在州最高法院审理。

ex.en: The city built two new tennis courts in the public park.
ex.zh: 市政府在公园里新建了两块网球场。

ex.en: He spent years at court before falling out of favour with the king.
ex.zh: 他在宫廷中待了多年，后来失宠于国王。

courteous.usage: adj.有礼貌的，谦恭的 根据arrays of 研究和相关computational 结果，cosmic 的起源来自于一次大bang，然后core 迅速扩散， 当恒星cease 扩散，也就会死去。今天想要了解宇宙，可以参加相关的curri

senses: n. 谦恭有礼,有礼的举止(或)言辞

phrases.m: 蒙…的好意(或准许),蒙…提供(或赠送)

senses: n. 求爱期,求爱,追求;(动物的)求偶;招商

ex.en: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
ex.zh: 正如人类纷繁复杂的求爱仪式可能都被视同雌雄选择的诸多形式一样，或许世界上的语言、音乐、社会及宗教习俗，甚至历史也都由许多普遍特征支配。

ex.en: During courtship, male birds often display colourful feathers to attract a mate.
ex.zh: 在求偶期间，雄鸟常常展示鲜艳的羽毛来吸引配偶。

ex.en: The company's courtship of its smaller rival lasted months before a formal offer was made.
ex.zh: 在正式提出报价之前，该公司对小竞争对手的追求持续了数月。

senses: n. 同辈表亲（或堂亲）；远房亲戚
n. 堂(或表)兄弟,堂(或表)姐妹

ex.en: My cousin, who studies environmental science, recently joined a research project on coastal erosion.
ex.zh: 我学环境科学的表哥最近加入了一项关于海岸侵蚀的研究项目。

senses: vt. 掩蔽；覆盖；包含；足以支付；行走；占；报道
v. 包括,涉及;足以支付,够付
cover.usage: v.覆盖，遮盖；包括，涉及 n.覆盖物；封面；①包括例2021年阅读；索引p405

ex.en: That supplies 80 percent of what is consumed, so even covering the whole country in livestock farms wouldn't allow us to cover all our meat and dairy needs.
ex.zh: 这些生产（为英国）提供了占其总消耗量80%的食物，所以即使畜牧农场覆盖整个国家，我们也无法满足（人们）全部的肉类和奶制品需求。

ex.en: The insurance policy covers damage caused by flooding.
ex.zh: 这份保险承保洪水造成的损失。

ex.en: The magazine cover showing the melting glacier drew national attention.
ex.zh: 展现消融冰川的那期杂志封面引起了全国关注。

ex.en: Two reporters were sent to cover the election campaign.
ex.zh: 两名记者被派去报道这次竞选活动。

senses: n. 新闻报道；覆盖范围

phrases.m: 神圣不可侵犯的思想、机构、制度等

ex.en: In many rural households, a single cow can provide both milk and a steady income.
ex.zh: 在许多农村家庭，一头奶牛既能提供牛奶，又能带来稳定的收入。

ex.en: I'm a real coward when it comes to going to the dentist.
ex.zh: 我一去看牙医就胆战心惊。

senses: a. （字迹）潦草的；乖戾的；易怒的
n. 裂缝，缝隙；破裂声，爆裂声
adj. 最好的，第一流的，精湛的
v. 重击；断裂；砸开；(使)发出爆裂声
n. 裂缝；爆裂声；重击；缝隙

ex.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered", a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
ex.zh: 他们已敦促该机构将该鸟类划归为“濒危物种”，这一等级赋予联邦官员更多的管制权去打击那些对它的威胁。

phrases.p: from the cradle to the grave

ex.en: The baby is crying in the cradle.
ex.zh: 宝宝在摇篮里啼哭。

senses: n. 工艺，手艺；诡计，手腕，骗术
n. 小船，船；飞机，飞船(pl. craft)
v. (指用手工)精心制作；周密制订
craft.usage: 他整天精心制作（craft）草稿（draft）。；②n.技艺（2013年阅读）：As Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.；索引p405

ex.en: He acquired the craft of paper cutting with the help of his English teacher.
ex.zh: 他在英语老师的帮助下掌握了剪纸这门手艺。

ex.en: A moralist, satirist, and social reformer, Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters that capture the panorama of English society.
ex.zh: 作为伦理学家、讽刺作家和社会改革家，狄更斯精心设计了复杂的故事情节和个性鲜明的人物，它们描绘了一幅英国社会的全貌图。

ex.en: Local craftsmen still weave baskets by hand, keeping a centuries-old craft alive.
ex.zh: 当地工匠仍手工编织篮子，让这门延续数百年的手艺保持活力。

ex.en: Each piece of furniture is shaped by hand by a craftsman trained in traditional joinery.
ex.zh: 每件家具都由受过传统细木工艺训练的工匠手工打造。

senses: adj. 狡诈的，诡计多端的

ex.en: Workers used an enormous crane to lift the steel beams onto the top floor.
ex.zh: 工人们用一台巨大的起重机把钢梁吊到顶楼。

crash.usage: c（联想成car“车”）+rash（鲁莽的）→开车不能太鲁莽，不然可能要出“撞车事故”。；索引p405

ex.en: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
ex.zh: 埃及航空公司804航班疑遭恐怖分子袭击而坠毁于地中海，这一悲剧再次提醒着人们为何支持安检。

ex.en: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
ex.zh: 数量的锐减是美国鱼类及野生动植物管理局(USFWS)决定正式将该鸟类列入“受威胁物种”名录的主要原因。

ex.en: The sudden stock market crash wiped out billions of dollars in household savings.
ex.zh: 股市突然崩盘使家庭储蓄损失了数十亿美元。

ex.en: The plane crashed into the mountainside in heavy fog.
ex.zh: 飞机在大雾中撞上了山坡。

senses: n. & v. 爬行；缓慢行进
crawl.usage: 螃蟹（crab）在沙滩上缓慢爬行（crawl）。

ex.en: Our baby is just starting to crawl.
ex.zh: 我们的宝宝刚开始会爬。

senses: n. (一时的)狂热,风行;风行一时的东西
a. 狂热的；傻的；疯狂的；迷恋的

ex.en: It sounds crazy, but the company's decision to stop advertising actually doubled its profits.
ex.zh: 这听起来很疯狂，但该公司停止做广告的决定实际上使利润翻了一番。

ex.en: Dermatologists warn that some skin creams contain chemicals that may irritate sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 皮肤科医生警告说，某些护肤霜所含的化学物质可能刺激敏感肌肤。

senses: vt. 创造；创建；发明；创作
create.usage: v.创造，创作；造成，引起； 授予，册封；词根：本身为词根，等于to make，意为创作；创造；索引p405

ex.en: The government plans to create more jobs for young people.
ex.zh: 政府计划为年轻人创造更多的就业机会。

ex.en: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of "Smiling Victorians" makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900.
ex.zh: 当然，我必须承认，在创作于1840年到1900年间的大量肖像摄影作品集中，我收集的“微笑的维多利亚时代的人”仅仅占一小部分。

ex.en: The dam created a lake that now supplies water to three provinces.
ex.zh: 大坝形成了一个湖泊，现在为三个省供水。

ex.en: The creation of new jobs depends heavily on a stable economic environment.
ex.zh: 新就业岗位的创造在很大程度上依赖于稳定的经济环境。

ex.en: The museum displays the artistic creations of young designers from across the country.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了全国各地年轻设计师的艺术作品。

ex.en: Scientists celebrated the creation of a material stronger than steel yet far lighter.
ex.zh: 科学家们庆祝了一种比钢更坚固却轻得多的材料的诞生。

senses: adj. 有创造力的,创造(性)的,创作的
adj. 创造性的，有创造力的
adj. 有创造力的；创造（性）的；（尤指艺术作品）创作的
n. 创意；富于创造力的人
creative.usage: adj.创造(性)的；有创造力 的 n.创作者；创意；索引p405

ex.en: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
ex.zh: 然而，在学习那门课程期间我意识到，在这个领域（指时尚设计领域），我并没有优秀到将来可以和其他那些有创造力的名人一较高低，所以我断定那条路不适合我。

ex.en: Creative solutions often emerge when teams are allowed to experiment freely.
ex.zh: 当团队可以自由试验时，富有创意的解决方案往往会出现。

ex.en: The city has invested heavily in its creative industries since the factories closed.
ex.zh: 工厂关闭后，这座城市大力投资创意产业。

ex.en: Teachers complain that standardised tests leave little room for creative thinking.
ex.zh: 教师们抱怨标准化测试几乎没有给创造性思维留下空间。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value creativity as highly as technical skill when recruiting graduates.
ex.zh: 在招聘毕业生时，雇主对创造力的重视程度日益不亚于专业技能。

creature.usage: n.生物，动物；人；creat(创造，创作)+ure(名词后缀)→创造出来的东西→生物；动物

ex.en: It is awesome to see these magnificent creatures in flight.
ex.zh: 看到这些漂亮的动物飞翔，真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: The forest is home to creatures found nowhere else on earth.
ex.zh: 这片森林是地球上其他地方找不到的生物的家园。

ex.en: Scientists studying deep-sea creatures have discovered several new species.
ex.zh: 研究深海生物的科学家发现了几个新物种。

ex.en: My grandfather was a quiet creature of habit, walking the same route every morning.
ex.zh: 我的祖父是个习惯成自然的安静之人，每天早晨走同一条路线。

senses: vt. 提供证明书（或证件）
n. [pl.] 证书；资格证书；证件

ex.en: Applicants must present their academic credentials before being considered for the research post.
ex.zh: 申请者必须出示学历证书，才会被考虑担任该研究职位。

credibility.usage: 词根：cred(trust信任)+ibil(…的)+ity名词后缀→可信性；索引p405

ex.en: Before you share your thoughts, think about what the powerful person cares about—it may be the credibility of their team or getting a project done on time.
ex.zh: 在你分享你的想法之前，想想那个掌握权力的人关心的是什么——可能是团队的可信性或者是按时完成一个项目。

senses: adj. 可信的;可靠的;有望成功的
credible.usage: adj.可信的，可靠的；可接受 的；credit card是信用卡，credit是"信用，相信"→credible就是"可信的"；索引p405

ex.en: He turned up credible evidence that music has positive effects on intelligence.
ex.zh: 他发现了音乐对智力有积极影响的可信的证据。

ex.en: The witness gave a credible account of how the accident happened.
ex.zh: 证人对事故经过作了可信的陈述。

ex.en: Without independent verification, the report is hardly credible.
ex.zh: 没有独立核实，这份报告很难令人信服。

ex.en: The team remains a credible contender for the championship.
ex.zh: 该队仍是冠军的有力争夺者。

senses: n. 赞扬,荣誉,功劳;信用,信贷;赊购;学分
vt. 信任,相信;把…归于;认为…有(某种优点或成就等)
n. 认可；学分；补助；信用
credit.usage: n.信用，信贷，赞扬，信誉； 学分 v.把钱存入(账户)；归功于；索引p405

ex.en: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
ex.zh: 一旦一项发现声明公诸于众,发现者就能获得学术上的声誉。

ex.en: She bought the laptop on credit and repaid it over a year.
ex.zh: 她用赊购的方式买了笔记本电脑，并用一年时间还清。

ex.en: The team deserves credit for completing the project ahead of schedule.
ex.zh: 团队提前完成项目，值得称赞。

ex.en: Students must earn thirty credits before they can graduate.
ex.zh: 学生必须修满三十个学分才能毕业。

credulous.usage: adj.轻信的；因轻信而产生的

senses: n. [C] 小海湾；小港湾；小河；小溪
n. (英)小湾,小港;(美)小河,小溪

ex.en: The village draws its drinking water from a creek that flows down from the mountains.
ex.zh: 这个村庄的饮用水取自一条从山上流下的小溪。

senses: vi. 不知不觉产生；匍匐
creep.usage: 辨析：creep 指贴地悄悄爬行；crawl 指虫类缓慢蠕动爬行；climb 指向高处爬；索引p405

ex.en: Doubts began to creep into her mind as the deadline approached without any progress.
ex.zh: 随着截止日期临近而毫无进展，疑虑开始悄悄涌上她的心头。

senses: n. [C]全体船员；一队工作人员
n. 全体乘务员，全体船员(通常单、复数相同)
n. 一群共同工作的人
n. 全体机务人员；全体工作人员；专业人员团队

ex.en: The captain ordered the crew to abandon ship when the fire spread to the engine room.
ex.zh: 当火势蔓延到机舱时，船长命令全体船员弃船。

ex.en: A film crew spent three weeks in the village recording the lives of local farmers.
ex.zh: 一个摄制组在村里待了三周，记录当地农民的生活。

ex.en: The rescue crew worked through the night to clear the fallen rocks from the road.
ex.zh: 救援队伍连夜清理路上的落石。

senses: n. 犯罪活动,违法行为
n. 罪，罪行；犯罪活动，不法行为
crime.usage: cri（联想成cry“哭”）+me（我）→罪犯最后审判时痛哭流涕，悔恨自己的“犯罪行为”。

ex.en: Official statistics show that violent crime has fallen sharply in the past decade.
ex.zh: 官方统计显示，过去十年暴力犯罪大幅下降。

ex.en: Poverty and poor education are often cited as root causes of crime.
ex.zh: 贫穷和教育匮乏常被引用为犯罪的根源。

ex.en: He was sentenced to five years in prison for the crime of fraud.
ex.zh: 他因诈骗罪被判处五年监禁。

senses: adj. 犯罪的,刑事的,不道德的
criminal.usage: 派生 criminality n. 犯罪,有罪,犯罪行为；索引p405

ex.en: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
ex.zh: 在定义某种并非犯罪的偏私行为时，法庭的裁决是合理合法的。

ex.en: The criminal was identified through DNA evidence left at the scene.
ex.zh: 那名罪犯通过在现场留下的DNA证据被确认。

ex.en: Pouring untreated waste into the river is a criminal offence.
ex.zh: 向河中倾倒未经处理的废水属于刑事犯罪。

ex.en: Detectives studied the criminal behaviour patterns of repeat offenders.
ex.zh: 侦探们研究了惯犯的犯罪行为模式。

senses: n. 跛子,伤残人(或动物)
n. 危机，危急关头；危难时刻；病危期
crisis.usage: n.危机，紧要关头；cri（联想成cry"哭"）+sis（名词后缀）→"危机"到了，很多人都会哭→危机；另：housing crisis住房危机；face an acute crisis in在…方面面临严重危机；handle the crisis应对危机；索引p405

ex.en: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis.
ex.zh: 在世界大部分地区，几乎没有危机的迹象。

ex.en: Quick action by the central bank prevented a local debt crisis from spreading across the region.
ex.zh: 中央银行的迅速行动防止了地方债务危机向整个地区蔓延。

ex.en: The hospital declared a crisis after running out of beds during the flu season.
ex.zh: 流感季节床位用尽后，医院宣布进入危机状态。

crisp.usage: 派生 crisply adv. 干脆地,斩钉截铁地；crispness n. 脆,易碎

ex.en: The bakery is famous for its crisp bread, which stays fresh for several days.
ex.zh: 这家面包店以酥脆的面包闻名，这种面包能保鲜好几天。

senses: n.（批评或作决定的）标准，准则
criterion.usage: n.标准，准则；crit（联想critic批评，评论）+er（人）+ion（名词后缀）→评论人的依据→标准；索引p405

ex.en: She failed to meet the strict selection criteria.
ex.zh: 她没有达到严格的选拔标准。

ex.en: Price should not be the only criterion when choosing safety equipment for children.
ex.zh: 为儿童挑选安全设备时，价格不应当是唯一标准。

ex.en: The main criterion for the award is originality rather than technical skill.
ex.zh: 该奖项的主要标准是原创性而非技术技巧。

senses: n. 批评者,批评家,评论家

ex.en: The film was hailed by critics as a triumphant piece of realism.
ex.zh: 评论家把这部电影誉为现实主义的杰作。

ex.en: Critics of the scheme argue that it will push up rents in the city center.
ex.zh: 该方案的批评者认为，它将推高市中心的租金。

ex.en: Even its sharpest critics admit that the new policy has reduced waiting times.
ex.zh: 即使是最尖锐的批评者也承认，新政策缩短了等待时间。

senses: a. 批评的；关键的；危急的
critical.usage: crit(判断)+-ical→作出判断的→批评的；[族] critic, criticism, criticize；adj.批判的；严重的；①关键的例2021年完形,②批评的例2012年阅读:Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that scientific wor

ex.en: A large part of evaluation is calling out bad arguments, but we also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
ex.zh: 大部分的评价都是在吹嘘不好的论点,但是我们也需要承认对手的好论点,并把同样的批评标准应用到我们自己身上。

ex.en: Maintaining control of the budget is absolutely critical for success.
ex.zh: 控制住预算对于成功极为重要。

ex.en: All good targets should have multiple criteria relating to critical factors such as time, money, quality and customer feedback.
ex.zh: 所有的好目标都应具有与关键因素如时间、金钱、质量和客户反馈相关的多个标准。

senses: adv. 极为重要地；批判地
critically.usage: adv.严重地；很大程度上；批 判性地；严谨地；索引p406

ex.en: Critically, another group was asked to spend a minute writing down reasons for their judgment, before giving the rating.
ex.zh: 极为重要的是，另一组被要求在给出评分前花一分钟写下他们做出判断的理由。

ex.en: We become defensive when criticized, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
ex.zh: 一旦受到批评，我们就会变得心存戒备，并用消极负面的成见来对待他人，以此增强自己的自尊心。

criticism.usage: n.批评，批判；评论，评价；词根记忆:crit(judge,判断)+ic(…的)+ism(名词后缀)→批评；索引p406

ex.en: The former minister is facing growing criticism over his remark.
ex.zh: 这位前部长因其言论正面临越来越多的批评。

ex.en: For the rest of the decade she apparently managed both roles without attracting much criticism.
ex.zh: 在接下来的十年里她没有招致太多非议，显然她很好地兼顾了这两种角色。

ex.en: The design met with fierce criticism from local residents, who said the tower was too tall.
ex.zh: 该设计遭到当地居民的激烈批评，他们说这座塔楼太高了。

ex.en: Some economists criticize the policy for doing too little to help small firms.
ex.zh: 一些经济学家批评该政策在帮扶小企业方面力度不够。

ex.en: It is easy to criticize others, but far harder to offer workable solutions.
ex.zh: 批评别人容易，提出可行的解决方案则难得多。

ex.en: The report was criticized by teachers who said its data were out of date.
ex.zh: 该报告受到教师们的批评，他们称其中的数据已经过时。

senses: v. 写评论,对……发表评论,评判

ex.en: Her essay offers a sharp critique of modern consumer culture.
ex.zh: 她的文章对现代消费文化提出了尖锐的批评。

ex.en: The professor asked students to critique each other's research proposals in class.
ex.zh: 教授要求学生在课堂上互相评判彼此的研究计划。

ex.en: The book is a thoughtful critique of the nation's healthcare system.
ex.zh: 这本书是对该国医疗体系的深入评析。

crop.usage: n.庄稼；收成；一批 v.剪短；剪裁；收获

ex.en: Farmers are switching to crops that need less water as droughts become more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着干旱越来越频繁，农民正转向种植需水较少的作物。

ex.en: This year's wheat crop was badly damaged by the unusual cold weather.
ex.zh: 今年的小麦收成因反常的寒冷天气而严重受损。

ex.en: The government hopes new technology will raise crop yields without expanding farmland.
ex.zh: 政府希望新技术能在不扩大农田的情况下提高作物产量。

senses: n. 叉字形记号；十字形记号
adj. 相反的,反向的,易怒的,发怒的
v. 越过,穿过,交叉,相交
cross.usage: 联想：祈好运时手指交叉说 finger-crossed；真题搭配 cross-cutting topics 跨领域话题；cross-check sources 反复核查；索引p406

ex.en: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15th-and-16th-century explorations of North America.
ex.zh: 15世纪和16世纪的探索发现了北美洲，在那之后又过了100多年，第一批满载移民的船只才横渡大西洋，驶向如今被称为美国的那片土地。

ex.en: A red cross marks the spot where the ancient treasure was found.
ex.zh: 红色十字标记出发现古代宝藏的地点。

ex.en: The bridge is the only safe way to cross the river during the flood season.
ex.zh: 洪水季节，这座桥是过河唯一安全的途径。

ex.en: From the cliff path we watched a crow circling slowly above the harvested fields.
ex.zh: 我们走在悬崖小径上，看着一只乌鸦在收割后的田野上空缓缓盘旋。

phrases.m: 大批涌入(某狭小空间内)
挤占某空间使某人/某物无法进入

crowd.usage: n.人群；一伙人；观众 v.聚集，群集；挤

ex.en: A large crowd gathered outside the courthouse to hear the verdict.
ex.zh: 大批人群聚集在法院外等待听取判决。

ex.en: Shoppers crowded into the store as soon as the holiday sale began.
ex.zh: 假日促销一开始，购物者便涌进商店。

ex.en: He tried to make his way through the crowd, but could barely move.
ex.zh: 他试图从人群中挤过去，但几乎动弹不得。

senses: a. 至关重要的；决定性的
a. 至关重要的，关键的
a. 至关重要的，决定性的
adj. 决定性的,关键性的
adj. 至关重要的；关键性的
crucial.usage: cruc(十字形)+-ial→处在十字路口的→至关重要的；[近] critical, vital；cruc（十字）+ial→处在十字路口的→关键的。近义：vital a. 极重要的；[族]crucially ad. 至关重要地；[近]key a. 关键的；crucial关键的,决定性的;critical紧要的,危急的,

ex.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values.
ex.zh: 许多美国人认为陪审团制度是关键民主价值观的具体体现。

ex.en: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
ex.zh: 但这并不意味着涉及人工智能的重要的道德伦理问题不会出现。

ex.en: The next two weeks will be crucial for the success of the vaccination campaign.
ex.zh: 接下来的两周对疫苗接种活动的成败至关重要。

senses: adj. 天然的，未加工的；粗俗的，粗鲁的
adj. 简陋的；粗糙的；粗鲁的
crude.usage: 派生 crudely adv. 粗略地；adj.粗略的，大概的；粗糙的； 冒犯的，粗俗的；天然的，自然 的 n.原油；天然的物质；有些人是粗鲁的(crude)，也是残忍的(cruel)；索引p406

ex.en: In most countries the cost of crude oil now accounts for a smaller share of the price of petrol than it did in the 1970s.
ex.zh: 与20世纪70年代相比，现在大多数国家的原油成本在汽油价格中所占的比例要小很多。

ex.en: It would be crude to judge a student's ability by a single test.
ex.zh: 仅凭一次考试来判断学生的能力是粗浅的。

ex.en: The villagers built crude shelters from wood and plastic sheeting.
ex.zh: 村民们用木板和塑料布搭起了简陋的住所。

ex.en: Crude oil prices fell sharply after the peace agreement was signed.
ex.zh: 和平协议签署后，原油价格大幅下跌。

cruel.usage: 辨析：cruel 既指行为又指态度,程度和语气比 brutal 弱；brutal 强调无同情心,指对粗野的人或弱者采用过分野蛮的手段

ex.en: Critics condemned the policy as cruel, arguing it would leave thousands of families homeless.
ex.zh: 批评者谴责这项政策残酷无情，认为它将使数千个家庭无家可归。

senses: n. [U] （尤指蓄意的）残酷，残忍，残暴
n. 海上航游,乘船游览

ex.en: The cruise along the Norwegian coast offers passengers spectacular views of glaciers and fjords.
ex.zh: 沿挪威海岸的乘船游览让乘客饱览冰川和峡湾的壮丽景色。

senses: vi. 坍塌；损坏；崩裂；（开始渐渐）衰退；崩溃；瓦解
v. (使)破碎,坍塌;崩溃,消亡;无力应付

ex.en: Support for the government began to crumble as unemployment rose for the sixth consecutive month.
ex.zh: 随着失业率连续第六个月上升，对政府的支持开始瓦解。

crush.usage: 辨析：crush 意为压碎、挤入、压垮、使变形；clash 意为冲突、抵触、发出碰撞声、不协调；crash 意为摔下、坠毁、碰撞

ex.en: The government moved quickly to crush the rebellion before it spread to the major cities.
ex.zh: 政府迅速行动，在叛乱蔓延到主要城市之前将其镇压下去。

ex.en: The reform plan was crushingly rejected, with more than seventy percent of members voting against it.
ex.zh: 改革方案遭到压倒性否决，超过七成的成员投了反对票。

ex.en: Beneath the Earth's crust lies a layer of hot rock that moves slowly over time.
ex.zh: 地壳之下是一层炽热的岩石，它随时间缓慢移动。

senses: n. [sing.] （难题或问题的）关键，最难点，症结

ex.en: The crux of the dispute is whether the new airport should be funded by public money.
ex.zh: 争执的关键在于新机场是否应由公共资金出资修建。

senses: n. 叫喊；恳求；一阵哭泣
n. 哭泣,哭声,叫喊,喊声

ex.en: She heard a faint cry for help coming from the flat above during the night.
ex.zh: 夜里她听到楼上的公寓传来微弱的呼救声。

senses: adj. 水晶的,清澈的,透明的
v. (使)明确；(使)具体化；(使)结晶

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: n. (大房间分隔出来的)小房间,小隔间

ex.en: The study found that adding cucumber to school meals increased children's intake of fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 研究发现，在学校餐食中添加黄瓜能提高儿童对新鲜蔬菜的摄入量。

ex.en: Actors must respond instantly to each visual cue so that the performance runs smoothly.
ex.zh: 演员必须对每个视觉提示立即做出反应，演出才能顺利进行。

senses: vi. （以某种结果）告终；（在某一点）结束
v. 达到顶点;(以某种结果)告终;(在某一点)结束

ex.en: Years of patient negotiation culminated in an agreement that both countries described as historic.
ex.zh: 多年耐心的谈判最终达成了一项两国都称之为历史性的协议。

senses: n. 罪犯;造成破坏(问题)的人
n. 问题的起因;困难的起源
n. 引起问题的人(或事物)；罪犯

ex.en: Investigators finally identified a faulty cable as the culprit behind the repeated power cuts.
ex.zh: 调查人员最终查明，一根故障电缆是反复停电的罪魁祸首。

cultivate.usage: cult（耕种）+iv+ate→耕种→培养。近义：foster vt. 培养；促进；同义①farm②develop,improve,train;cultivator n.耕种者,耕耘机；v.开垦，耕作；培养；老师们希望把学生们培养（cultivate）成有文化的（cultural）人才；词根记忆：cul(till,耕作

ex.en: The land here has been intensively cultivated for generations.
ex.zh: 这片土地经过了几代人的精耕细作。

ex.en: They gave justices permanent positions so they would be free to upset those in power and have no need to cultivate political support.
ex.zh: 他们赋予法官终身职位，因此法官可以自由触怒那些当权者，并且无需培养支持自己的政治势力。

ex.en: Reading widely from an early age helps cultivate a lifelong love of learning.
ex.zh: 从幼年起广泛阅读有助于培养终身热爱学习的习惯。

senses: adj. 有教养的；有修养的

ex.en: The cultivation of rice on terraced fields has shaped the landscape of the region for centuries.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，梯田水稻的耕作塑造了该地区的地貌。

senses: adj. 文化的;与文化有关的;教养的
cultural.usage: 真题搭配：cultural events 文化事件；索引p406

ex.en: Cultural differences can lead to misunderstandings in international business.
ex.zh: 文化差异可能导致国际商务中的误解。

ex.en: The museum plays a central role in the city's cultural life.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆在城市文化生活中扮演着核心角色。

ex.en: Immigrants often face pressure to abandon their cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 移民常常面临放弃自身文化传统的压力。

culture.usage: n.文化，文明；习俗；栽培，种 植；索引p406

ex.en: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
ex.zh: 他们认为，文化小镇奖可以成为一项年度盛事，吸引投资并创造就业机会。

ex.en: Corporate culture shapes how employees respond to risk.
ex.zh: 企业文化影响着员工应对风险的方式。

ex.en: Ancient Greek culture laid the foundations of Western philosophy.
ex.zh: 古希腊文化奠定了西方哲学的基础。

ex.en: A culture of excessively long working hours damages both health and productivity.
ex.zh: 超长工时的文化既损害健康又损害生产率。

senses: adj. (在力量或重要性方面)聚积的,积累的,渐增的

cunning.usage: 派生 cunningly adv. 狡猾地,巧妙地；adj.狡猾的，诡诈的；巧妙的 n.狡猾，诡诈；索引p406

ex.en: In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.
ex.zh: 在(其传记作品)《君主论》中，他赞同成功的领袖应该具有狡猾、冷酷、勇敢这类品质，而非美德、仁慈、公正。

ex.en: The fox used cunning to escape the hunters' traps.
ex.zh: 狐狸凭着狡猾逃脱了猎人的陷阱。

ex.en: She devised a cunning plan to expose the company's false advertising.
ex.zh: 她设计了一个巧妙的计划来揭露该公司的虚假广告。

senses: n. [C] 杯子；奖杯；一杯的量

ex.en: She poured herself a cup of tea and settled down to read the morning papers.
ex.zh: 她给自己倒了一杯茶，坐下来阅读晨报。

ex.en: She searched every cupboard in the kitchen but could not find the spare keys.
ex.zh: 她翻遍了厨房的每个橱柜，也没能找到备用钥匙。

curb.usage: 近义：restrain vt. 抑制；控制；v./n.控制，抑制；cur(联想成occur“发生”)+b(联想成“不”)→不想让一件事情发生，就要“控制、抑制”它；①抑制例2020年阅读,②n.抑制例2010年阅读:Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic

ex.en: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face.
ex.zh: 对商业方法专利申请的限制将是一个戏剧性的转变。

ex.en: The French Senate has passed a bill to curb the influence of advertising.
ex.zh: 法国参议院通过了一项限制广告影响的法案。

ex.en: The city introduced parking fees to curb the use of private cars downtown.
ex.zh: 该市引入停车收费制度，以抑制市中心的私家车使用。

phrases.m: 不是全胜就是大败,孤注一掷

cure.usage: n.疗法；对策，措施；治愈， 治疗 v.治愈；索引p406

ex.en: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfillment and opportunity for all.
ex.zh: 科学技术将解决人类所有的问题，为所有人带来幸福满足和充满机遇的生活。

ex.en: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
ex.zh: 这里提到的社会救治措施最明显的一个缺陷就是它无法长期有效地发挥作用。

ex.en: Doctors have yet to find a cure for the common cold.
ex.zh: 医生们尚未找到治愈普通感冒的疗法。

ex.en: The new drug cured nine out of ten patients in the trial.
ex.zh: 在试验中，这种新药治愈了十分之九的患者。

ex.en: Experts caution that no single technology can serve as a cure-all for climate change.
ex.zh: 专家提醒，没有任何一种单一技术能成为应对气候变化的灵丹妙药。

ex.en: Children learn best when their natural curiosity is encouraged rather than suppressed.
ex.zh: 当孩子天生的好奇心得到鼓励而非压制时，他们学得最好。

ex.en: Out of curiosity, she opened the old box hidden at the back of the drawer.
ex.zh: 出于好奇，她打开了藏在抽屉深处的旧盒子。

ex.en: Scientific progress often begins with simple curiosity about how things work.
ex.zh: 科学进步往往始于对事物运作方式的朴素好奇。

senses: adj. 难以理解的；好奇的
curious.usage: adj.好奇的，求知欲强的；不寻 常的；词根记忆: cur(take care, 关心)+ious→非常关心的→好奇的；索引p406

ex.en: For something curious has been happening in American universities, and Louis Menand, a professor of English at Harvard University, captured it skillfully.
ex.zh: 因为某件不同寻常的事情一直在美国大学里发生，而哈佛大学英语专业的路易斯·梅南德教授敏锐地捕捉到了这一点。

ex.en: Children are naturally curious about how machines work.
ex.zh: 孩子们天生对机器的运作方式感到好奇。

ex.en: It is curious that no one reported the missing files earlier.
ex.zh: 奇怪的是，之前没有人报告这些文件丢失。

ex.en: Curious visitors kept asking the guide about the castle's hidden passages.
ex.zh: 好奇的游客不断向导游打听这座城堡的暗道。

senses: n. 鬈发,卷曲状,卷曲物

ex.en: The sudden fall in the currency made imports far more expensive.
ex.zh: 货币突然贬值使进口商品贵了许多。

ex.en: Many tourists prefer to exchange money at banks rather than at airport currency counters.
ex.zh: 许多游客更愿意在银行而不是机场货币兑换处换钱。

ex.en: His ideas gained wide currency among young researchers in the field.
ex.zh: 他的观点在这一领域的年轻研究者中广泛流传。

senses: a. 现时的，当前的，现行的
current.usage: curr(发生)+-ent→现阶段正在发生的→当前的；族currently，近present；[族] currently ad. 当前；现在；an electric current 电流；货币（currency）是商品“流通的”（current）媒介。；索引p406

ex.en: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery although it is the subject of current research.
ex.zh: 整个图像是如何被组装和感知的仍然是一个谜,尽管它是当前研究的主题。

ex.en: "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said.
ex.zh: 他说：“孩子们在应对重大变动时可能会面临严重的困难，特别是如果这一变动会使他们离开现在的学校或支持体系时更是如此。”

ex.en: That is before we look for the space to grow the grains, sugars, seeds and oils that provide us with the vast bulk of our current calorie intake.
ex.zh: 这还是在我们找到地方种植谷物、糖类、种子和油类作物之前——这些作物提供我们目前摄入的大部分热量。

ex.en: The company is currently testing its driverless cars in three cities.
ex.zh: 该公司目前正在三个城市测试其无人驾驶汽车。

ex.en: She is currently working on a book about the history of immigration.
ex.zh: 她目前正在撰写一本关于移民史的著作。

ex.en: Currently, more than half of the world's population lives in urban areas.
ex.zh: 目前，世界一半以上的人口居住在城市地区。

senses: n. 课程,(学校等的)全部课程

phrases.p: the basic mandatory high school curriculum

ex.en: All children should have access to the mainstream curriculum.
ex.zh: 所有的孩子都应该有机会接触主流课程。

ex.en: Computer science has been added to the national curriculum for primary schools.
ex.zh: 计算机科学已被纳入全国小学课程。

ex.en: Critics argue that the curriculum places too much emphasis on memorisation.
ex.zh: 批评者认为该课程过于强调死记硬背。

ex.en: The school reviews its curriculum every three years to keep it relevant.
ex.zh: 该校每三年审查一次课程设置，以保持其现实适用性。

curse.usage: [反] blessing 祝福；发音类似"渴死"→很渴的时候会不自觉抱怨咒骂→咒骂

ex.en: He cursed himself for his stupidity.
ex.zh: 他咒骂自己愚蠢。

ex.en: Unemployment remains a curse that affects generations in some regions.
ex.zh: 在一些地区，失业仍是影响几代人的祸根。

ex.en: According to the legend, the treasure carried a terrible curse.
ex.zh: 传说中，这份宝藏带有可怕的诅咒。

ex.en: Even a cursory glance at the data reveals a clear link between diet and health.
ex.zh: 即使粗略一看数据，也能发现饮食与健康之间的明显联系。

ex.en: Thick curtains help to keep the room warm by blocking cold air from the windows.
ex.zh: 厚重的窗帘能挡住窗外的冷空气，有助于保持室内温暖。

senses: vt.&vi. （使）沿曲线运动；呈曲线形

phrases.p: plot a curve on a graph

ex.en: Drivers are warned to slow down on the sharp curve approaching the old bridge.
ex.zh: 司机们被提醒，在通往旧桥的急弯处要减速慢行。

ex.en: Airbags act as a cushion, protecting passengers from the worst effects of a collision.
ex.zh: 安全气囊起到缓冲垫的作用，保护乘客免受碰撞的最严重伤害。

custom.usage: 本身为词根，意为“习惯”→在某地流行的习惯和传统→习俗；[族] customary a. 习俗的；[近] tradition n. 传统；辨析：custom 指个人或地区、民族不允许破坏的传统习惯；habit 指个人重复太多而成的自动习惯；convention 指社会生活中共同遵守的传统习惯做法、规矩；真 social

ex.en: She grew up with Chinese customs and traditions.
ex.zh: 她在中国的风俗习惯中长大。

ex.en: It is a local custom to exchange small gifts during the spring festival.
ex.zh: 春节期间互赠小礼物是当地的风俗。

ex.en: His custom of walking to work kept him healthy for decades.
ex.zh: 他步行上班的习惯使他几十年来一直保持健康。

ex.en: It is customary in the region to remove your shoes before entering someone's home.
ex.zh: 在该地区，进别人家门前先脱鞋是一种习俗。

customer.usage: n.顾客，客户；家伙；真 customer feedback 顾客反馈；customer loyalty 顾客忠诚度；customer service 客户服务；索引p406

ex.en: The ability to guard customer data is the key to market value.
ex.zh: 保护消费者信息的能力是市场价值的关键因素。

ex.en: The store offers free delivery for customers who spend more than fifty dollars.
ex.zh: 这家商店为消费超过五十美元的顾客提供免费送货。

ex.en: Online reviews now strongly influence how new customers choose among competing brands.
ex.zh: 网络评论如今强烈影响着新顾客如何在相互竞争的品牌之间做选择。

customs.usage: 设置海关（customs）是多数国家的习惯（custom）。

ex.en: We had to fill out customs forms on the plane.
ex.zh: 我们得在飞机上填写报关单。

cut.usage: cut用利器破开或除去一部分;saw锯;hack劈砍毁坏清除;slash挥刀猛砍;tear手扯破;cut down削减;cut in插嘴;cut out删去;cut short打断;反义link

ex.en: The company announced plans to cut hundreds of jobs in an effort to reduce costs.
ex.zh: 该公司宣布计划裁减数百个岗位，以努力削减成本。

senses: adj. 漂亮的,可爱的,小巧玲珑的
n. 餐具(刀、叉、匙等);刀具
n. 计算机空间,网络空间,虚拟现实

phrases.p: separate fact from fiction in cyberspace
phrases.m: 区分网络空间里的真真假假

cyberspace.usage: [记] cyber（网络的）+space（空间）→网络空间；索引p406

ex.en: Governments are struggling to regulate commercial activity in cyberspace.
ex.zh: 各国政府正努力规范网络空间中的商业活动。

ex.en: Millions of users share personal information in cyberspace every day.
ex.zh: 每天有数百万用户在网络空间分享个人信息。

ex.en: Experts warn that children face new risks as their lives move into cyberspace.
ex.zh: 专家警告说，随着生活转入网络空间，儿童面临新的风险。

phrases.p: the life cycle of the insect

cycle.usage: 本身为词根，意为“圆”→重复从圆形跑道的起点跑向终点的过程→循环；[族] cyclic a. 周期的；cyclist n. 骑自行车的人；派生 cyclic adj. 循环的,有规律地重复的

ex.en: Economists remain divided over where the economy stands in its current cycle of expansion and contraction.
ex.zh: 经济学家对经济目前处于扩张与收缩周期的哪个阶段仍存在分歧。

senses: n. 愤世嫉俗者;悲观者;怀疑者

ex.en: The report recommends thirty minutes of daily exercise to maintain both physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 报告建议每天锻炼三十分钟，以保持身体和心理健康。

ex.en: A growing number of consumers are switching from dairy milk to plant-based alternatives.
ex.zh: 越来越多的消费者正从牛奶转向植物基替代品。

ex.en: This may not only do damage to your relationship with your child but also affect your child's self-esteem.
ex.zh: 这不仅可能会破坏你和孩子之间的关系，而且还可能会影响孩子的自尊。

ex.en: The storm caused severe damage to crops along the eastern coast.
ex.zh: 风暴对东部沿海的农作物造成了严重损害。

ex.en: Smoking damages the lungs and raises the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 吸烟损害肺部并增加患心脏病的风险。

senses: adj. 该死的(表示不满、愤怒、不耐烦等)
vt. 罚(某人)入地狱受罪；严厉地批评；表示厌烦,愤怒

ex.en: Reviewers damned the play for its weak plot, though they praised the lead actor's performance.
ex.zh: 评论家们因剧情薄弱而抨击这部戏剧，不过他们称赞了男主角的表演。

phrases.m: 使(兴趣、热情等)降低,抑制

damp.usage: 【记】地下室很潮湿。反dry a.干燥的；词组damp off(植物因水多而)腐坏;damp-proof course(=damp course)防湿层；dam(大坝)+p(联想place“地方”)→有大坝的地方一般比较“潮湿”→潮湿的

ex.en: The walls were damp, and patches of mould had begun to spread.
ex.zh: 墙壁很潮湿，一片片霉菌开始蔓延。

ex.en: Her clothes were damp with sweat after the long climb.
ex.zh: 长途攀爬之后，她的衣服被汗水浸湿了。

ex.en: Damp air in winter makes old houses feel even colder.
ex.zh: 冬天潮湿的空气让老房子感觉更冷。

senses: vt. 使潮湿；弄湿；减弱，抑制（热情、激动等）
v. 弄湿,使潮湿;抑制,控制,减弱(情感、反应等)
v. 抑制，控制，减弱（感情、反应等）；弄湿

ex.en: Nothing could dampen their enthusiasm for the final match.
ex.zh: 什么也浇不灭他们对决赛的热情。

ex.en: Rising borrowing costs dampened demand for new homes.
ex.zh: 不断上升的借贷成本抑制了新房需求。

ex.en: He dampened the cloth and wiped the dust off the shelf.
ex.zh: 他把布弄湿，擦去了架子上的灰尘。

senses: n. 舞步；舞会；跳舞；舞曲

ex.en: Traditional dance is taught in local schools to keep the region's cultural heritage alive.
ex.zh: 当地学校教授传统舞蹈，以使该地区的文化遗产得以延续。

senses: n. 危险的事物（或人）；威胁

ex.en: Engineers warned that the cracked pipeline posed a serious danger to nearby residents.
ex.zh: 工程师们警告说，破裂的管道对附近居民构成严重危险。

ex.en: Few politicians dare to question the subsidy, fearing a backlash from rural voters.
ex.zh: 很少有政客敢质疑这项补贴，因为担心农村选民的强烈反对。
